mechanism: Carvedilol, a non-selective beta-blocker, masks hypoglycemic symptoms and may impair glucose recovery by reducing hepatic glucose output and impairing counterregulatory hormone response to hypoglycemia.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, educate patient on non-adrenergic hypoglycemia symptoms, consider alternative antihypertensive if frequent hypoglycemic episodes occur, and inform patient that beta-blockers may reduce awareness of hypoglycemia.
